title: The GitHub API stub answers a request sent on a kept-alive socket while the test loop is busy, instead of resetting it
steps: S1: Run node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/github-api-stub.test.mjs. A child process sends GET /user, then POST /graphql on the same kept-alive socket while the test process holds its event loop for 7 s from the check phase.
expect: S1: the test passes: the child prints status 200 and the stub logged GET /user then POST /graphql; no ECONNRESET / fetch failed.
evidence: CI: wo-export-public conflict twice failed with POST /pulls: network error reaching the loopback stub (fetch failed). Stress before the fix 6 of 15 failed, after 0 of 31; the new test is red 3 of 3 on the old stub
fence: The stub HTTP server keep-alive behaviour: no idle timeout racing a busy test event loop
